browserChecks.scope: Actual final fresh Onager public blueprint loaded through production App setShip/deserialization and worker statistics/geometry. No stock constructor rerun, geometry/profile interception or render substitution. Screenshots use native normal/xray controls. Separate controlled firing proof covers trusted single-emitter firing and continuous-beam framebuffer. On the merged main runtime, the initial App draft includes the owned hull structure; factory archive and App draft counts are recorded separately. Native input moves actual gun46 by1m while pending, native Undo restores it, and actual stale worker replies cannot reapply the moved pose. Read-only message/upload observers never substitute geometry or profiles. A single-weapon highlight uses the exposed editor selection API without changing the design.

Controlled tiny 100 m box and explicit two-superweapon profile. Real App boot, trialStart, native key/button dispatch and WebGL beam. This does not validate the stock Onager factory or production catalogue.
